says: catchup.sh merges main into the head once, waits up to an hour for checks, then squashes pinned to the head only; it never reads main again, and the ruleset's up-to-date rule is bypassed by the merging role, so a pull request lands on a main its checks never saw
proof: PR 736: its check job log says `HEAD is now at 882abc9 Merge d878f7a1c7e0ceab178903b6a18747f7e8a03bc0 into 31f57ddfd7fb488a05fd53bd4a4ea97430551b48` and `All matched files use the correct format. Finished in 270ms on 1303 files`; PR 729 landed on main as 49e84ef65 at 09:54:28Z and added clauderow.test.ts; PR 736 was squashed as b24f989be at 10:01:39Z with no new catch-up. `gh api repos/usirin/tea-fabrika/rulesets/rule-suites/5017407739` printed result `bypass`, with required_status_checks `fail`. Main's run 42795622646 failed `pnpm lint`: `Format issues found in above 1 files`. Run again here with the same oxfmt flags: exit 0 on d878f7a1 merged with 31f57ddf (1303 files), exit 1 on b24f989be (1304 files). Of the last 20 merges to main, 12 had a head behind main by 1 to 6 commits, and those 12 are exactly the rule suites with result `bypass`
cost: any blocking check can pass on a pull request and fail on main after the merge; today one such merge turned main's lint red until PR 742, and 11 more landed untested on their final tree

says: A `// oxlint-disable-next-line` comment for a rule that is on only in the .agents/ block cannot be used in .agents/ code, though decision 0033 says edges there use the same comment as next/: oxlint also reads each file through its .claude/skills link, where that block does not apply, and reports the comment as unused, which blocks.
proof: With 12 such comments for fabrika/no-why-key in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/drive.ts, drive.test.ts and box.test.ts, `node oxlint-plugins/lint.ts` printed 12 lines of the form `.claude/skills/lead/scripts/drive.ts:320:2 Unused oxlint-disable directive (no problems were reported).` and `oxlint: 13 blocking`; without the comments the same 12 lines were reported under .agents/ as fabrika(no-why-key).
cost: Every rule that fits .agents/ badly on one line needs a ledger entry and the owner's yes instead of a marked edge, and each file under .agents/skills is linted twice.

proof: the main ruleset has strict_required_status_checks_policy true (`gh api repos/<repo>/rulesets/<id>`), and the script has no second merge of main after its wait. Three pull requests merged on 2026-11-10 each carry two `Merge main into` commits from two runs: 665 (08:01:09Z and 08:03:27Z), 702 (06:43:29Z and 07:06:07Z, main moved at 06:52:35Z) and 696 (06:11:46Z and 06:53:10Z, main moved at 06:17:11Z). cost: with about twelve agents landing work, a catch-up can lose its whole wait for CI and needs an agent to start it again; each retry is one more full CI run
